info.name: No-Code UI Automation API
info.description: Postman collection for testing the No-Code UI Automation Backend (Phase 1)

request.description: Check if the server is running and healthy

body.raw:
{
  "featureText": "Feature: Browse Example Website
  Scenario: User navigates to example.com
    Given I navigate to https://example.com
    When I wait for the page to load
    Then I should see the example page title",
  "retryCount": 2
}

request.description: Test Playwright navigation - visits example.com and verifies page load

body.raw:
{
  "featureText": "Feature: Click Button Test
  Scenario: User clicks on elements
    Given I navigate to https://example.com
    When I hover over the main heading
    And I scroll down the page
    Then the page should be scrolled",
  "retryCount": 2
}

request.description: Test Playwright click and scroll actions

body.raw:
{
  "featureText": "Feature: Form Filling
  Scenario: User fills a text input field
    Given I navigate to https://example.com
    When I find an input field and type test data
    Then the input should contain the typed text",
  "retryCount": 2
}

request.description: Test Playwright text input and typing actions

body.raw:
{
  "featureText": "Feature: Extract Content
  Scenario: User extracts page text content
    Given I navigate to https://example.com
    When I extract the page content
    Then I should see text content from the page",
  "retryCount": 2
}

{
  "featureText": "Feature: Checkbox Test
  Scenario: User interacts with checkboxes
    Given I navigate to https://example.com
    When I find a checkbox on the page
    And I check the checkbox
    Then the checkbox should be checked",
  "retryCount": 2
}

{
  "featureText": "Feature: Dropdown Selection
  Scenario: User selects from a dropdown
    Given I navigate to https://example.com
    When I find a select dropdown on the page
    And I select an option from the dropdown
    Then the option should be selected",
  "retryCount": 2
}

{
  "featureText": "Feature: Wait for Element

request.description: Test Playwright wait for element visibility

body.raw:
{
  "featureText": "Feature: Complex User Workflow
  Scenario: User performs multiple actions in sequence
    Given I navigate to https://example.com
    When I wait for the page to load
    And I extract the page title
    And I hover over the main heading
    And I scroll down the page
    Then I should have captured screenshots of each action",
  "retryCount": 3
}

request.description: Test Playwright with a complex multi-step workflow

body.raw:
{
  "featureText": "Feature: Get Page Information
  Scenario: User retrieves page information
    Given I navigate to https://example.com

    And I get the current URL
    Then I should have page metadata",
  "retryCount": 2
}

request.description: Test Playwright page information retrieval (title, URL)

body.raw:

request.description: Test Playwright error handling for non-existent elements

item.name: Groq AI Interpretation - Verify Step Understanding

body.raw:
{
  "featureText": "Feature: AI Interpretation

    When I enter my email address in the email field
    And I type my password in the password field
    And I press the login button
